description:
Append an event to a lot's history (manufacturers only). Requires
'Authorization: Bearer <key>' with a key from PRIVI_WRITE_KEYS. Over stdio,
writes are allowed only when PRIVI_ALLOW_LOCAL_WRITES=1.

event_type.description: One of: received, produced, inspected, shipped, transferred, recalled
event_type.title: Event Type

location.description: Where it happened, e.g. 'Plant 2, Port Huron MI'
location.title: Location

name: privi_record_event
title: Record a lot event
